slides.title: functools: partial and lru_cache
slides.prompt: The 'functools' module provides tools for working with higher-order functions. 'partial()' allows freezing a portion of a function's arguments to produce a new function, while '@lru_cache' caches return values of expensive calls.

slides.title: Partial Function Import
slides.prompt: Fill in the correct function name imported from functools to freeze function arguments.

slides.title: LRU Cache Meaning
slides.prompt: What does 'LRU' stand for in the @lru_cache decorator?

slides.title: LRU Cache Clear
slides.prompt: Fill in the method name used to clear all cached results from an @lru_cache decorated function.

slides.title: LRU Cache Argument Requirement
slides.prompt: What condition must function arguments meet to be used with @lru_cache?
options: Arguments must be hashable (e.g., numbers, strings, tuples)
Arguments must be mutable lists or dictionaries
Arguments must be instances of custom classes only
Arguments must be positional arguments only
slides.correctAnswer: Arguments must be hashable (e.g., numbers, strings, tuples)
